newsitem.title: USA: Apache may take stake in Polish project.
newsitem.headline: Apache may take stake in Polish project.

text.p: Apache Corp on Thursday it signed a letter of intent to enter an agreement with FX Energy Inc calling for Apache to become operator of a Polish energy exploration project, with a 50 percent interest in the venture.

The project involves a tract of about two million acres, including eight blocks near the city of Lublin, about 100 miles southeast of Warsaw. The agreement would mark Apache's first venture in Eastern Europe, the company said.

Under the terms of the proposal, Apache will be obligated to drill at least one well and conduct some 300 miles of two-dimensional seismic surveys during the next year at a cost of about $5.0 million, it said.
Apache may drill more wells if geological, geophysical and seismic evaluations warrant.
Apache and FX Energy also identified an area of mutual interest covering about four million acres on adjacent blocks, Apache said.
